findings: Change `formation.type` from `indicative` to `unknown`, and revise `formation.text` so it does not assert an indicative formation. The three strokes are described as a conventional sign for the numeral; the counting-rod account is a qualified paleographic interpretation, while Shuowen’s Heaven–Earth–humanity account is a later interpretation. The evidence does not establish an indicator-mark origin or prove that the graph was devised by copying rods (E1, E2, X-cf2e4185c438e7569f0f, X-8c0f487b4c1e18b89eff, X-718d8d468383943ee429).
